separateCorrectnessIssue.status: Fixed in regular export; test all 101 progress values against approved C16 geometry.
separateCorrectnessIssue.issue: The personalization pass changes the steps ring conditions from >= to ==, assuming complete arcs. C16 actually uses short cumulative convex segments. At 34%, the approved C16 shows 34 segments; current perf-5 shows only segment 34.
separateCorrectnessIssue.nextAction: Verify the restored ring on the phone when importing the regular widget. No latency improvement claimed.
separateCorrectnessIssue.diagnosticBaseline: perf5DiagnosticBaseline is explicitly applied only by the temporary diagnostic page, keeping its prior ring conditions for a controlled timing comparison. Normal copy and Calendar setup flows never import this compatibility transform.
